Visual V2 experimental assets

Primary hamster
- Model: オリジナル3Dモデル「ハムちゃん/Hamster」 by 如月十二
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0), as stated on the BOOTH product page
- Source: https://booth.pm/en/items/2621226
- Original package: Ham.zip / Ham.unitypackage
- Web derivative: Ham.fbx converted locally to hamchan-cc0.glb with FBX2glTF 0.9.7-p1
- Converted GLB retains 1 skin with 41 joints and the embedded hamster texture; the downloaded FBX contains no animation stack.

Fallback/reference hamster
- Model: Hamster by Poly by Google
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0)
- License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
- Source: https://poly.pizza/m/3YtzEQ5TVUP
- Kept only as an earlier lightweight prototype/reference asset.

Furniture
- Assets: Furniture Kit 2.0 by Kenney
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit

Animation test animal
- Asset: Cube Pets 2.0 / animal-bunny by Kenney
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/cube-pets
- Used only as an AnimationMixer pipeline stand-in, not as the final hamster character.

Runtime
- Three.js 0.186.0
- License: MIT
- Source: https://threejs.org/

These assets are used only in the independent V2 visual prototype at this stage. The published 2D game remains unchanged.
